mapper.update: INSERT INTO subsidy (merge_key, date_of_approval, title, amount, target, government_departments) VALUES (#{mergeKey}, #{dateOfApproval}::date, #{title}, #{amount}::bigint, #{target}, #{governmentDepartments}) ON CONFLICT (merge_key) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO company_subsidy (company_id, subsidy_id, inserted_at, updated_at, deleted, sync_id) SELECT c.company_id, s.subsidy_id, now(), now(), false, #{syncId}::uuid FROM company c JOIN subsidy s ON s.merge_key = #{dto.mergeKey} WHERE c.corporate_number = #{dto.corporateNumber} ON CONFLICT (company_id, subsidy_id) DO UPDATE SET deleted = false, updated_at = now(), sync_id = EXCLUDED.sync_id WHERE company_subsidy.deleted IS DISTINCT FROM false OR company_subsidy.sync_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.sync_id
UPDATE company_subsidy cs SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE cs.deleted = false AND cs.company_id = ( SELECT c.company_id FROM company c WHERE c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber} )

UPDATE company_subsidy cs SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE cs.deleted = false AND cs.company_id = ( SELECT c.company_id FROM company c WHERE c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber} ) AND cs.sync_id IS DISTINCT FROM #{syncId}::uuid
